title: BIP Evidence Record Schema
description: Schema for traceable factual evidence supporting architectural claims and resource behaviors.

tag_type.description: Evidence tag type per BIP and D-039 protocol.

source_id.description: Optional direct reference to source record if tag_type is REF or PARTIAL-EVIDENCE.

location_ref.description: Precise file location, line range, or teardown citation reference.

claim.description: The architectural or behavioral assertion being evaluated.

observed_fact.description: The factual reality directly verified on disk or in product behavior, distinguished from inferences.

confidence_level.description: Confidence assessment of the claim based on observed facts.

verifier.description: Agent role, tool, or authority who performed the verification.

verified_at.description: Timestamp of verification in ISO 8601 format.
